description: A link to a2bflight.com's group page for people flying from different homes to meet in one place. Use it when the user already knows where; where_to_meet when they ask where. Without dates it picks the weekend whose round trips we have seen price everyone, with each fare and the total; with dates it quotes no price, and the page shows each person's cheapest fare we have seen for them or the closest. A warning says why the fares are a poor option and what to try instead: pass it on.

back.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the day everyone flies home

members.description: 2 to 8 people, each flying from their own home; person 1 first

adults.description: how many adults fly from this home together; omit for 1

home.description: the person's home IATA airport, such as JFK — an airport, not a city code

mode.description: cheapest_total (the default: the lowest sum), fairest (the lowest dearest ticket), least_travel (the least flying time) or earliest_together (everyone landed soonest)

out.description: YYYY-MM-DD: the day they meet; leave out and back both empty for a suggested long weekend

to.description: the IATA airport where they all meet — an airport, not a city code

name: meet_link

dates.description: asked: the user's dates; priced: the weekend of the next eight whose round trips we have seen price everyone, cheapest summed; suggested: no weekend does, so a long weekend three weeks out, whose page links each person to a live search

fares.description: on priced dates, each person's cheapest round trip, in the order of members

book_url.description: opens the seller's booking page for this fare

checked.description: the day we last checked this route — not the day the price was seen, which can be days earlier

departs.description: local departure time with the airport's offset

duration.description: flying time; on a return, both directions together

lands.description: local arrival time with the airport's offset

month.description: YYYY-MM, on a per-month row that has no single date

page_url.description: the route's page on a2bflight.com — give the user this link first

seen.description: the day this price was seen; absent when we know only the day we last checked it

stops.description: connections; on a return, both directions together

meet_url.description: the group's page on a2bflight.com with everyone filled in — give the user this link

total.description: on priced dates, the fares added up; absent when anyone is more than one adult or the currencies differ

warning.description: why these fares are a poor option and what to try instead — tell the user both

title: Group trip link
